title: Avaya Inc - proposed acquisition of Enterprise Solutions business of Nortel Networks Corporation
targets: Enterprise Solutions business of Nortel Networks Corporation

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Avaya Inc proposed to acquire the Enterprise Solutions (ES) business of Nortel Networks Corporation.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of the following national markets: - the supply of enterprise telephony; and - the supply of contact centre solutions.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to lead to a substantially lessening of competition in the relevant markets on the basis that: -the overlap between Avaya and Nortel ES would not result in any significant aggregation of market shares; and -the merged entity would continue to be competitively constrained by existing competitors.
